system.description:
You attune yourself to light, becoming either a shimmering beacon or a shifting mass of shadow.

Choose either Brightness or Darkness. Until the start of your next turn, you gain the associated effect.

  • Brightness

    • You become a radiant beacon of light.

    • All spaces adjacent to you are well-lit.

    • All creatures adjacent to you must make an opposed Resilience check or become Blinded until they move away from you.

    • You cannot be Blinded by bright light.

  • Darkness

    • You are cloaked in shadow.

    • All spaces adjacent to you are considered dimly lit and Obscured (2), though you can see normally.

    • Your Defense increases by +2 and the Difficulty of Perception checks made by other creatures increases by +2.

    • You can see normally in darkness.

Each extra success extends the duration by +1 rounds.
